C0769.title: 900,000 Exam Candidates' Data Leaked: Sichuan Police Crack Major Personal Information Infringement Case
C0769.summary: Sichuan police uncovered a massive personal information infringement case during a summer security operation. A vice principal, head teachers, and others exploited their access to leak over 900,000 student records. Five suspects were detained on suspicion of infringing citizens' personal information.
